svg.text: Why the picture wobbles: the game's frames against the 50 Hz mains hum
every frame starts at the same point of the hum: the picture stands still
48 fps: a slightly busy scene needs 31,250 cycles a frame
each frame starts a little later in the hum: the picture sways slowly (twice a second)
every frame starts two whole hum waves later - the same point again: still
blue: a frame starts (0.2 s shown) - white dot: where the hum is at that moment = how far the picture is pushed
